title: 21 U.S. Code § 853(p) - Forfeiture of substitute property
publisher: Legal Information Institute (Cornell) - text of U.S. Code
notes: Round 1 (fact-check of C006). §853(p)(1)(A) lists as the first trigger for substitute-asset forfeiture property that 'cannot be located upon the exercise of due diligence'. The identical wording already appears in the 2024 indictment's boilerplate substitute-assets provision (S006 ¶40 p.18). The admission in S033 is therefore the statutory predicate for chasing other assets - a standard formula, not a narrative confession that the money vanished.
